publication_note: Core: 26 public scenarios across JMeter, k6, Locust and Gatling (104 tasks). Anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5 uses adaptive thinking at high effort (thinking-high), a 64,000-token output cap, and one conditional repair round. The board scores the first answer; after-repair scores remain in the saved results. Costs include all 104 first tries and 24 repair responses, estimated from reported token usage at frozen registry prices, not provider invoices. Published from Actions run https://github.com/QAInsights/p95-bench/actions/runs/45066297860; merged manifest f07f902e5bf1542afa91818eb962abbdb4873c8999983f17ff7a983a685fc9de.
